race.description: Fiona Sandkuhl 2026 Apprentice Jockey Of The Year Hcp (Bm65)
race.comment: KHALS (7) earns top billing after a determined BM60 win at this track, where he overcame a wide middle-stage run and still beat Beta Better by a head. The rise from BM60 and the return to 1400m both ask something of him, but he is race fit, handles wet ground and keeps Ryan Wiggins, who has already won on him. ASK ME MATE (3) has the safer distance profile, with two wins and one placing from four starts at 1400m, and his last-start fourth behind Fabulean reads better after being bumped near the 250m. INTRUDER (2) is a genuine danger freshened since a narrow third behind Ready Tiger, with an easy recent trial, first-time blinkers and a 3kg claim all adding to the case. TORANAGA (4) lacks their winning edge but has been highly consistent, drops from Class 6 company and brings proven track-and-trip form into another suitable assignment.
